business.name: Riverbend Auto Care
business.tagline: Honest repairs, done when we said they'd be done.
business.description: A family-run repair shop serving the Riverbend neighborhood since 1998. We handle everything from oil changes to full engine work, and we explain what we found before we touch anything.

services.name: Diagnostics
services.description: Check-engine lights, odd noises, and problems the last shop could not find.

services.name: Brakes & Suspension
services.description: Pads, rotors, struts, and alignment, with the worn parts shown to you.

services.name: Oil & Scheduled Maintenance
services.description: Manufacturer-interval service that keeps your warranty intact.

services.name: Engine & Transmission
services.description: Major repairs and rebuilds, quoted in writing before work begins.

about.story: Dale Ortiz opened the shop with two bays and a hand-lettered sign. Twenty-five years later his daughter runs the front desk, and about half our customers still come from someone telling a neighbor we were fair with them.

staff.name: Dale Ortiz
staff.bio: ASE Master certified, 30 years under the hood, still the first one in most mornings.

staff.name: Marisol Ortiz
staff.bio: Handles scheduling and estimates, and will talk you out of a repair you do not need.
